# Mieyo Manufacturing Concern
A long-standing eastern manufacturer that rose to some level prominence after the dissolution of NanoTrasen; they have poor offensive capabilities, but great force multipliers and industrial potential.
Their operations in Colossus consist of the single goal of making money for the company, and fufilling the desires of the Board of Directors. They operate independently and neutrally on the trading post of Hokkaido, and are capable of producing a large amount of industrial and combat utilities to sell to civilians and factions alike.
